summary: Defines Opaque LSAs for OSPF, a generalized way to carry application-specific information using standard flooding, so OSPF can be extended later. It adds a mechanism for validating AS-scope Opaque LSAs originated outside a router's area. It replaces RFC 2370. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: OSPF routers share maps. An opaque LSA is a sealed note that routers pass along that other programs can use later.
